test_title: PYST 31: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Defamatory
solution: The correct answer is '**Complimentary**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Let us look at the word meaning, __ • **Defamatory** means intended to **harm somebody** by **saying** or **writing bad** or **false things** about him/her, (किसी व्यक्ति के बारे में झूठे बयानों को संप्रेषित करने का कार्य) • For eg:- The article was highly defamatory. • **Complimentary** means expressing a **compliment**; **praising or approving. (**प्रशंसा व्यक्त करना**)** So, the correct word opposite to '**Defamatory'** is '**Complimentary'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Now let's look at the others word meaning, • **Slandering** means making **false **and **damaging** statements about **(someone)**, ((किसी के बारे में) झूठा और हानिकारक बयान देना) • **Insulting** to act in a way or say something that is **offensive** or **rude to someone**. (ऐसा कुछ कहना जो किसी के लिए अपमानजनक या असभ्य हो।) • **Unflattering**:- **not flattering**, or making someone look** less attractive** or **seem worse**. (किसी को कम आकर्षक दिखाना या बुरा दिखाना।) 40:Tacb, The erroneous spelling is **"Accomodate".**
